meta.title: Tsippo explores the world
meta.description: Join Tsippo on an adventure: camera on, red backpack on, all around the world.

hero.birdAlt: Tsippo with a red backpack and camera, sitting on a compass
hero.pigeonAlt: A carrier pigeon flies past with a letter
hero.worldAlt: A colourful world map with Tsippo on a skateboard, bike, boat, bus, tram and scooter

friends.title: A new friend everywhere
friends.intro: Wherever Tsippo lands, he always takes a photo. And usually makes a new friend too! Tap a photo to read his postcard.

london.caption: London
london.text: From the top of the red double-decker I can see all of London. Look, there's Big Ben!
london.alt: Tsippo and a boy on top of a red London double-decker bus

amsterdam.caption: Amsterdam, with Mike
amsterdam.text: At first Mike the cat didn't want to come. But now he thinks cycling along the canals is quite fun!
amsterdam.alt: Tsippo rides a blue bicycle with Mike the cat in the basket

norway.caption: Norway
norway.text: I'm sailing the fjords with a real Viking. What big waves!
norway.alt: Tsippo and a Viking on a ship with a dragon head

vienna.caption: Vienna, with Leopold
vienna.text: Leopold sings the whole ride through Vienna. I just sing along: tra-la-la!
vienna.alt: Tsippo and Leopold singing on the box of a horse-drawn carriage

rome.caption: Rome, with Matteo
rome.text: Helmets on, off we go! I zoom past the Colosseum on Matteo's Vespa.
rome.alt: Tsippo and Matteo wearing helmets on a red Vespa

spain.caption: Spain, with Carmen
spain.text: Carmen is teaching me flamenco. Clap, clap, twirl… oops, my backpack!
spain.alt: Tsippo dances flamenco with Carmen in a red dress

skater.caption: Somewhere on the way
skater.text: Where are we? No idea! But skateboarding with my friend is super fast.
skater.alt: Tsippo and a girl with braids riding a skateboard together

friends.mapAlt: A painted map of Europe with famous buildings such as Big Ben, the Eiffel Tower and the Colosseum

privacy.metaDescription: This website uses just one cookie, to remember your language, and does not track you. Read exactly what does and doesn't happen.
privacy.title: One cookie, no snooping
privacy.lead: Tsippo loves to travel, not to snoop around. This website doesn't track you, shows no ads and shares nothing with anyone.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This website uses just one cookie: tsippo-lang. When you pick a language with the NL or EN button, this cookie remembers your choice for a year, so the website opens in your language next time. It only contains "nl" or "en" and is shared with no one.

There are no statistics or advertising cookies, no Google Analytics and no tracking by Facebook, Instagram or anyone else. A language cookie needs no consent, which is why you don't see a cookie banner. Want it gone? Delete it in your browser settings; the website keeps working as normal.

sections.title: What is stored on your device
body: After the opening screen with flying Tsippo, we keep one tiny note in your browser ("sessionStorage", named tsippo-splash-seen), so you only see that screen once per visit. It contains nothing personal, is never sent anywhere and disappears by itself when you close the browser.

sections.title: Fonts and pictures
body: All fonts, drawings and photos come from this website itself. Your browser does not contact Google or any other service to show the page.

sections.title: If you send an email
body: If you write to {email}, we only use your email address and message to reply to you. We share them with no one and delete them when they are no longer needed.

sections.title: Amazon and Instagram
body: When you click a button to buy the book or our Instagram link, you go to the Amazon or Instagram website. Only there do their own privacy and cookie rules apply. While you are on this website, nothing of theirs is loaded.

sections.title: Hosting
body: As with any website, the company that hosts it processes technical data, such as your IP address, to deliver the pages to you and keep the website secure. We don't use that data to track you.

sections.title: Children
body: This website is made for children and their parents. We never ask children for any information and collect nothing about them.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Want to know what data we have about you, or have it corrected or deleted? Email {email}. If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
